approval.modal.heading: Approve {company}
approval.tier.none: Create a tier first. A tier sets the wholesale prices this buyer will see.
approval.field.checkoutToDraft: Send orders to me for review as drafts
approval.field.checkoutToDraftHelp: The buyer submits the order and you confirm it before it's charged.
approval.tax.reason.us_resale_certificat: The buyer uploaded a US resale certificate for this state.
approval.tax.reason.us_state_unknown: We couldn't tell which US state the resale certificate is for. Choose the exemption yourself.
approval.tax.reason.store_outside_eu: Your store isn't in the EU, so the EU reverse charge doesn't apply.
approval.tax.reason.same_country: The buyer is in the same EU country as your store, so the reverse charge doesn't apply.
approval.tax.reason.vat_not_verified: The VAT number isn't verified, so we don't suggest the EU reverse charge. Check it before exempting.
approval.tax.reason.eu_reverse_charge: The buyer has a verified VAT number from another EU country.
approval.tax.reason.none: No exemption applies automatically. You can still choose one.
approval.field.sameShipping: Shipping address is the same as billing
approval.address.zoneHelp: Use the short code, for example TX or ON.
approval.address.countryHelp: Two letters, for example US or DE.
approval.contact.otherCompany: This customer is already a contact of {company}. They'll be able to order for both companies.
approval.contact.willCreate: We'll create a new customer for {name} ({email}).
approval.welcome.shopify: Shopify's B2B welcome email, with a link to sign in.
approval.welcome.ours: Tradepass's "You're approved" email in the buyer's language.
approval.progress.done: Approved. The buyer can now sign in and see their prices.
approval.progress.assisted: One more step: add the company location to the tier's market in Shopify. The task is on your Tiers page.
approval.quota.heading: You've used this month's free approvals
approval.quota.body: The Free plan includes {limit} approvals a month. New applications are still collected. Upgrade to approve more now.
approval.error.field.exemption: Choose at least one exemption, or turn off Tax exempt.
approval.error.field.country: Enter a two-letter country code, for example US.
approval.error.network: We couldn't reach Shopify. Try again in a minute.
approval.error.busy: Another approval is updating this store's tiers. Try again in a moment.
approval.error.concurrent: Someone changed the tier's market at the same time. Try again; nothing was duplicated.
approval.error.verify_failed: Shopify didn't confirm the change when we checked. Try again.
approval.error.missing_in_shopify: Something this step needs was deleted in Shopify admin. Retry creates it again.
approval.error.tier_missing: This tier's market or catalog is missing in Shopify. Fix the tier on the Tiers page, then retry.
approval.error.catalog_limit: Your plan's B2B catalog limit is reached.
approval.error.markets_unavailable: B2B markets aren't available on this store. Check that new Shopify Markets is turned on.
approval.error.contact_email_taken: A customer with this email already exists, but we can't look them up. Link the existing customer instead.
approval.error.contact_email_missing: The application has no email address for the contact.
approval.error.no_contact_role: This company has no contact roles in Shopify, so the contact can't be given ordering access.
approval.error.email_failed: The welcome email couldn't be sent. The buyer is approved; you can send it again.
approval.error.no_b2b: B2B isn't available on this store's Shopify plan.
approval.error.volume_pricing: The selected catalog uses volume pricing or quantity rules, which B2B markets don't support here.
approval.error.catalog_in_use: Another tier already uses this catalog.
approval.error.not_found: We couldn't find this item. It may have been deleted.
approval.blocked.plan_limit: You've used this month's free approvals. Upgrade to approve more; applications are still collected.
approval.blocked.not_pending: This application isn't waiting for a decision.
approval.blocked.busy: This application is being approved right now. Wait a moment.
approval.blocked.no_state: There's nothing to retry for this application.
approval.blocked.finished: This approval is complete, so it can't be undone here. Use Change tier or Pause on the buyer instead.
approval.blocked.missing_address: Add a billing address with street, city and country.
approval.blocked.failed: Something went wrong. Nothing was lost; try again.
approval.skip.plan_limit: Free plan limit reached for this month.
approval.skip.tier_missing: The chosen tier no longer exists.
approval.skip.busy: Being approved by someone else right now.
